Dialogue.Text: Oho! You've finally opened your eyes!

Dialogue.Speaker: 끄적이
Dialogue.Text: Eek! Who are you?! ...More importantly, who am I?

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: Hohoho! You're a Doodle, freshly born!

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: I'll explain later! A bunch of rascals are rushing this way right now!

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: Now then, first things first. Go guard that wall!

Lines:
Want to power up your Skill with the materials you got?
Tap the Skill tab below!

You can upgrade with the materials you got.
Tap the Upgrade button!

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: Oho! Not bad for someone just drawn!

Dialogue.Speaker: 끄적이
Dialogue.Text: Whew...! I never thought I'd go through this right after being born!

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: Hohoho! To survive in this world, you'll need to get stronger.

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: Of course! Use the materials you got to power yourself up!

Lines:
Now let's fix up your gear!
Tap the Character tab below!

You can upgrade the hood with the materials you received.
Tap the Upgrade button!
Tap OK to upgrade your gear!

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: Oho! You protected the second gate safely too!

Dialogue.Speaker: 끄적이
Dialogue.Text: Whew...! It's getting pretty tough, isn't it?

Dialogue.Speaker: 슥삭 선생
Dialogue.Text: This time I'll help you tune up your gear. Open the Character screen!
